findings.text: the new case drives `crew ledger` bare, `--view records` and `--view findings` but not `--view summary`, the retired command's default view (`click.Choice(["summary", "records", "findings"])`, default="summary" on the base crew_ledger), so the one legal value the operand mapping routes to `crew view summary` rather than to the row's `ledger` positional is the one the guard never exercises; a regression scoped to that value would not redden.

the record still states that the records document is compared against the same read over MCP, the assertion this commit replaced; tests/test_ledger.py:2431 now asserts `records["runs"] == []` against a literal, so the evidence fragment describes a guard the change removed.

with operand_flag set, `crew ledger --view summary` renders as `reckon crew view summary` while bare `crew ledger` renders as `reckon crew view ledger`, and the payload's `successor` field says `crew view ledger` for both; the same retired document reached explicitly and by default is handed to two different views and the successor/invocation fields disagree.
